children.value: > Fact From Story: The case argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > Fact From Story: It also specifically cites new AI technologies like Google’s Search Generative Experience (SGE) and Bard AI chatbot as worsening the problem.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Siphoning something off from someone harms them.
> Fact From Story: Helena World Chronicle filed a class action lawsuit against Google and parent company Alphabet.
> > Fact From Story: The suit points to Google’s older question-and-answer technologies, like the “Knowledge Graph” launched in May 2012, as part of the problem.
> > Fact From Story: The case argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.

> > > > Fact From Story: The case, filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle, argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > > > Fact From Story: Helena World Chronicle owns and publishes two weekly newspapers in Arkansas.
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: If a company is based in a state, it is located in that state.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies don't want their content, readers, and ad revenue siphoned off.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Lawsuits are filed in response to perceived harm.
